features: MagSafe magnetic SD + microSD card reader for USB-C iPhone, iPad, Android phones & tablets
Dual slots support up to 2 TB SD + 2 TB microSD and both can be used simultaneously
USB Type-C 3.2 Gen 1 interface with DDR200 speeds: up to 160 MB/s read and 120 MB/s write
100 W PD 3.0 USB-C input for pass-through charging while transferring files
Instantly free up phone memory and shoot 4K/8K without storage anxiety
Plug & Play with no special apps - manage files via OS native File Folders
Keep content private & secure - store locally and skip the cloud when you want
